title: Social Clubs & Community Groups Cross-Feed Daily Correlation
dataSources: Club attendance (`club:attendance`), running-club sessions (`runningclub:session`), maker-space visits (`makerspace:visit`), book-club meetings (`bookclub:meeting`), community events (`community:event`).
app: Book-club attendance, running-club miles, maker-space visits, and general social-club participation logs streamed to Splunk HEC via forms, check-ins, and calendar exports.
spl:
(index=personal sourcetype=bookclub:meeting) OR (index=personal sourcetype=runningclub:session)
| bin _time span=1d
| eval feed=case(sourcetype="bookclub:meeting","primary",sourcetype="runningclub:session","secondary",1=1,"other")
| stats count as events by _time feed
| chart sum(events) over _time by feed
description: Lines up daily volume from bookclub:meeting and runningclub:session to see whether two social clubs feeds move together.
value: When two related exports diverge — one busy, one silent — it usually means a connector broke on only one path.
implementation: Forward both `bookclub:meeting` and `runningclub:session` into `index=personal` and compare daily counts on one chart.
visualization: Dual-line chart of daily events per sourcetype.
grandmaExplanation: It shows whether your two main social clubs data feeds rise and fall together or if one of them quietly stopped keeping up.
